title: Multiplatform Networking and Storage
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of multiplatform networking and storage using at least one correct term from the lesson.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Multiplatform Networking and Storage** as part of **Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform**. Kotlin Multiplatform organizes shared logic and target-specific implementations through source sets; only APIs available for every configured target belong in common code. Use the subtopics—Shared HTTP Clients, Shared Serialization, Platform Storage Abstractions—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Multiplatform work succeeds when shared code depends only on common APIs and platform-specific code is isolated behind deliberate interfaces.
